title: Ask for Gustavo
text: Gustavo was great -  he tailor made the tour to suit our interests and he was knowledgeable and funny in all areas of the tour - highly recommended- ask for gustavo
author: Bruce_T

title: ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Amazing Experience...
text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Amazing Experience in Barcelona!

We had a wonderful experience on this tour in Barcelona! Renzo was extremely nice, friendly, and welcoming. He made us feel comfortable throughout the experience and ensured we had a great time. The tour was enjoyable, interesting, and well organized. We really appreciated the kindness and professionalism of our guide. Such a lovely experience and a great way to explore Barcelona. Highly recommended to anyone visiting the city!
author: Carolyn_I

title: What a wonderful time!
text: This was our first ever Tuk-Tuk tour! Marcel provided a very enjoyable 3 hour relaxed paced afternoon tour. Marcel's  knowledge, including textbook & personal history was interesting & informative. We had been busy earlier in the day debarking ship, being transferred to hotel, etc. & had not looked at our phones. Tuk-Tuk had attempted to contact us to inform of necessary 30 minute delay due to a large festival impacting traffic. We arrived to the starting point via taxi cab, someone from Tuk-Tuk met us-telling us of delay and walked us to a street cafe for a quick meal. Marcel picked us up at

title: Richie, the tour guide.
text: Our tour guide, Richie, was excellent. Well informed, showed us beautiful sites, and told us all about them. If we do this again, we would like to have Richie with us again.
